drivingQuestion: What does 'Hebron was built seven years before Zoan' mean, given Egypt is older than Canaan?
outcomeNote: נבנתה means sevenfold more fertile; the figures reconcile to the baraita's 50,000 kor in blessed years

segments.he: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: בְּבִרְכוֹתֶיהָ שֶׁל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל — בֵּית סְאָה עוֹשָׂה חֲמֵשֶׁת רִיבּוֹא כּוֹרִין, בִּישִׁיבָתָהּ שֶׁל צוֹעַן — בֵּית סְאָה עוֹשָׂה שִׁבְעִים כּוֹרִין. דְּתַנְיָא, אָמַר רַבִּי מֵאִיר: אֲנִי רָאִיתִי בְּבִקְעַת בֵּית שְׁאָן בֵּית סְאָה עוֹשָׂה שִׁבְעִים כּוֹרִין.
segments.en: § «The Sages taught: In» years of «blessings of Eretz Yisrael,» an area of land measuring «one beit se’a produces fifty thousand kor.» By way of comparison, «when Zoan,» a fertile region in Egypt, «was settled, one beit se’a» there «would produce» only «seventy kor. As it is taught» in a baraita that «Rabbi Meir said: I saw in the valley of Beit She’an» that one «beit se’a produced seventy kor,» which teaches that the soil of a good-quality and irrigated stretch of land outside the borders of Eretz Yisrael will naturally yield this quantity of produce.

segments.he: וְאֵין לְךָ מְעוּלָּה בְּכׇל אֲרָצוֹת יוֹתֵר מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״כְּגַן ה׳ כְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם״. וְאֵין לְךָ מְעוּלָּה בְּכׇל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם יוֹתֵר מִצּוֹעַן — דַּהֲווֹ מְרַבּוּ בַּהּ מְלָכִים, דִּכְתִיב: ״כִּי הָיוּ בְצוֹעַן שָׂרָיו״. וְאֵין לְךָ טְרָשִׁים בְּכׇל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל יוֹתֵר מֵחֶבְרוֹן, דַּהֲווֹ קָבְרִי בָּהּ שָׁיכְבֵי.
segments.en: «And you have no more outstanding» earth «among all the lands» other «than the land of Egypt, as it is stated: “Like the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt”» (Genesis 13:10). «And you have no more outstanding» region «in all of the land of Egypt than Zoan.» The superior quality of Zoan is derived from the fact «that they would raise kings there, as it is written: “For his princes are at Zoan”» (Isaiah 30:4). «And you have no rockier» terrain «in all of Eretz Yisrael than Hebron, as» people «would bury» their «dead there,» e.g., the Patriarchs in the Cave of Machpelah, because the land was not arable.

segments.he: וַאֲפִילּוּ הָכִי, חֶבְרוֹן מְבוּנָּה עַל אַחַת מִשִּׁבְעָה בְּצוֹעַן, דִּכְתִיב: ״וְחֶבְרוֹן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים נִבְנְתָה לִפְנֵי צוֹעַן מִצְרָיִם״, מַאי ״נִבְנְתָה״? אִילֵימָא נִבְנְתָה מַמָּשׁ, אֶפְשָׁר אָדָם בּוֹנֶה בַּיִת לִבְנוֹ קָטָן קוֹדֶם שֶׁיִּבְנֶה לִבְנוֹ גָּדוֹל? שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וּבְנֵי חָם כּוּשׁ וּמִצְרַיִם וּפוּט וּכְנָעַן״!
segments.en: «And even so, Hebron was more developed,» i.e., more fertile, «than Zoan» by «sevenfold, as it is written: “Now Hebron was built [nivneta] seven years before Zoan in Egypt”» (Numbers 13:22). «What» is the meaning of the term: «Nivneta,» in this verse? «If we say» it means «literally» that Hebron «was built» before Zoan, «would a person build a house for his younger son before building» one «for his older son? As it is stated: “And the sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, and Put, and Canaan”» (Genesis 10:6), which indicates that Egypt, Mizraim, was older than Canaan, in whose territory Hebron was located.

segments.he: אֶלָּא שֶׁמְּבוּנָּה עַל אַחַת מִשִּׁבְעָה בְּצוֹעֵן. וְהָנֵי מִילֵּי בִּטְרָשִׁים, אֲבָל שֶׁלֹּא בִּטְרָשִׁים — חֲמֵשׁ מְאָה.
segments.en: «Rather,» the meaning of the verse is that Hebron «was more developed» and more fertile «than Zoan» by «sevenfold,» which means that Hebron produced 490 kor, seven times more than the seventy kor of regular fertile land, as stated above. «And this applies only to the rocky» terrain of Eretz Yisrael, e.g., Hebron, «whereas» those parts of Eretz Yisrael that were «not rocky» produced even more, up to «five hundred» kor.

segments.he: וְהָנֵי מִילֵּי שֶׁלֹּא בְּבִרְכוֹתֶיהָ, אֲבָל בְּבִרְכוֹתֶיהָ, כְּתִיב: ״וַיִּזְרַע יִצְחָק בָּאָרֶץ הַהִיא וְגוֹ׳״.
segments.en: «And this applies» only «to» a year when Eretz Yisrael is «not blessed. However,» with regard to a year «when it was blessed, it is written: “And Isaac sowed in that land,» and found in the same year a hundredfold” (Genesis 26:12). Isaac’s field produced one hundred times the normal yield, which according to the above calculations is fifty thousand kor, as stated in the baraita.

segments.he: תַּנְיָא, אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי: סְאָה בִּיהוּדָה הָיְתָה עוֹשָׂה חָמֵשׁ סְאִין: סְאָה קֶמַח, סְאָה סֹלֶת, סְאָה סוּבִּין, סְאָה מוּרְסִין, וּסְאָה קִיבּוֹרְיָא. אֲמַר לֵיהּ הָהוּא צַדּוּקִי לְרַבִּי חֲנִינָא: יָאֵה מְשַׁבְּחִיתוּ בַּהּ בְּאַרְעֲכוֹן. בֵּית סְאָה אַחַת הִנִּיחַ לִי אַבָּא, מִמֶּנָּה מְשַׁח, מִמֶּנָּה חֲמַר, מִמֶּנָּה עִיבוּר, מִמֶּנָּה קִיטְנִיּוֹת, מִמֶּנָּה רוֹעוֹת מִקְנָתִי.
segments.en: § «It is taught» in a baraita that «Rabbi Yosei said: A se’a» of wheat «in Judea would produce five se’a.» How so? It would yield «a se’a of flour; a se’a of fine flour; a se’a of bran» fiber, from the outer layer of the grain; «a se’a of coarse bran,» i.e., flour mixed with bran fiber; «and a se’a of cibarium [kiburaya],» inferior flour. «A certain Sadducee said to Rabbi Ḥanina: You have done well in praising your land;» my «father left me one beit se’a» of land in Eretz Yisrael «and from it» I am able to produce «oil, from it» I produce «wine, from it» I grow «produce, from it» I grow «legumes,» and with it I provide pasture from which «my sheep graze.»

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ הָהוּא בַּר אֱמוֹרָאָה לְבַר אַרְעָא דְיִשְׂרָאֵל: הַאי [תָּאלְתָּא] דְּקָיְימָא אַגּוּדָּא דְיַרְדְּנָא כַּמָּה גָּדְרִיתוּ מִינַּהּ? אֲמַר לֵיהּ: שִׁיתִּין כּוֹרֵי. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: אַכַּתִּי לָא עָיְילִיתוּ בָּהּ אַחְרֵיבְתּוּהָ, אֲנַן מְאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כּוֹרֵי הֲוָה גָּזְרִינַן מִינַּהּ. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: אֲנָא נָמֵי מֵחַד גִּיסָא קָאָמֵינָא לָךְ.
segments.en: «A certain Amorite» once «said to» a resident «of Eretz Yisrael: That palm tree which stands on the banks of the Jordan, how many» dates «are you able to pick from it? He said to him: Sixty kor.» The Amorite «said to him: You have not yet» fully «entered» Eretz Yisrael and yet «you have» already succeeded in «destroying it. We would pick off that» tree «120 kor.» The resident «said to him: I too am speaking to you» about only «one side» of the tree, as I have not yet picked the fruit off the other side.

segments.he: אָמַר רַב חִסְדָּא, מַאי דִּכְתִיב: ״וְאֶתֶּן לָךְ אֶרֶץ חֶמְדָּה נַחֲלַת צְבִי״, לָמָּה אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל נִמְשְׁלָה לִצְבִי? לוֹמַר לְךָ: מָה צְבִי זֶה אֵין עוֹרוֹ מַחֲזִיק בְּשָׂרוֹ, אַף אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵינָהּ מַחְזֶקֶת פֵּירוֹתֶיהָ. דָּבָר אַחֵר: מָה צְבִי זֶה קַל מִכׇּל הַחַיּוֹת, אַף אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל קַלָּה מִכׇּל הָאֲרָצוֹת לְבַשֵּׁל אֶת פֵּירוֹתֶיהָ.
segments.en: § «Rav Ḥisda said: What is» the meaning of that «which is written: “And give you a pleasant land, the goodliest [tzvi] heritage”» (Jeremiah 3:19)? «Why is Eretz Yisrael likened to a deer [tzvi]?» This comparison comes «to tell you» that «just as» with regard to «this deer, its skin cannot contain its meat» once it has been skinned, «so too, Eretz Yisrael cannot contain its fruit» once it has been picked, due to the great quantity of the produce. «Alternatively, just as this deer is swifter than all the» other «beasts, so too Eretz Yisrael is swifter to ripen its fruit than all» the other «countries.»

segments.he: אִי מָה צְבִי זֶה קַל וְאֵין בְּשָׂרוֹ שָׁמֵן — אַף אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל קַלָּה לְבַשֵּׁל וְאֵין פֵּירוֹתֶיהָ שְׁמֵנִים, תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר: ״זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ״, שְׁמֵנִים מֵחָלָב וּמְתוּקִים מִדְּבַשׁ.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «If» so, one can suggest the following comparison: «Just as this deer is swift and its meat is not fatty, so too, Eretz Yisrael is swift to ripen» its fruit «but its fruit is not fat» and juicy. The Gemara explains: For this reason «the verse states: “Flowing with milk and honey”» (Exodus 3:8), to say that its fruit is «fat» and juicier «than milk and sweeter than honey.»

segments.he: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר כִּי הֲוָה סָלֵיק לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, אָמַר: פְּלַטִי לִי מֵחֲדָא. כִּי סַמְכוּהוּ, אֲמַר: פְּלַטִי לִי מִתַּרְתֵּי. כִּי אוֹתְבוּהוּ בְּסוֹד הָעִיבּוּר, אֲמַר: פְּלַטִי לִי מִתְּלָת,
segments.en: § The Gemara relates that «when Rabbi Elazar ascended to Eretz Yisrael he said: I have been spared one» curse. «When they ordained him» and awarded him the title of Rabbi, «he said: I have been spared two. When they appointed him to sit in the council» of Sages who dealt with the «intercalation of the calendar, he said: I have been spared three.»

segments.he: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְהָיְתָה יָדִי אֶל הַנְּבִיאִים הַחוֹזִים שָׁוְא וְגוֹ׳״. ״בְּסוֹד עַמִּי לֹא יִהְיוּ״ — זֶה סוֹד עִיבּוּר. ״וּבִכְתָב בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יִכָּתֵבוּ״ — זֶה סְמִיכָה. ״וְאֶל אַדְמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יָבוֹאוּ״ — כְּמַשְׁמָעוֹ.
segments.en: «As it is stated: “And My hand shall be against the prophets that see vanity,» and that divine lies; they shall not be in the council of My people, neither shall they be written in the register of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and you shall know that I am the Lord God” (Ezekiel 13:9). «“They shall not be in the council of My people,” this» is referring to «the council» of the «intercalation of the calendar; “neither shall they be written in the register of the house of Israel,” this» is referring to «ordination; “neither shall they enter into the land of Israel,”» this is understood «as per its plain meaning.» Rabbi Elazar merited that these three curses were not fulfilled in him.

segments.he: רַבִּי זֵירָא כִּי הֲוָה סָלֵיק לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל לָא אַשְׁכַּח מַבָּרָא לְמֶעְבַּר, נְקַט בְּמִצְרָא וְקָעָבַר. אֲמַר לֵיהּ הָהוּא צַדּוּקִי: עַמָּא פְּזִיזָא, דְּקַדְּמִיתוּ פּוּמַּיְיכוּ לְאוּדְנַיְיכוּ, אַכַּתִּי בִּפְזִיזוּתַיְיכוּ קָיְימִיתוּ? אֲמַר לֵיהּ: דּוּכְתָּא דְּמֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן לָא זְכוֹ לַהּ, אֲנָא מִי יֵימַר דְּזָכֵינָא לַהּ.
segments.en: § «When Rabbi Zeira ascended to Eretz Yisrael he could not find a ferry to cross» the Jordan River. «He took hold of a rope» that was strung across as a makeshift bridge «and crossed» the Jordan. «A certain Sadducee said to him: Hasty people who put your mouths before your ears,» when you said at the time of the giving of the Torah: “We will do” before “we will hear” (Exodus 24:7), «you remain hasty» to this day. Why couldn’t you wait a little longer to cross the river on a ferry? Rabbi Zeira «said to him:» This is «a place where Moses and Aaron did not merit» entering; «who is to say that I will merit» seeing this land? I hurried across before anything might occur to prevent my entrance into Eretz Yisrael.

moves.cueHe: תנו רבנן: בברכותיה של ארץ ישראל
moves.summary: baraita: blessed Israel yields 50,000 kor per beit se'a; Zoan 70
moves.about: a beit se'a of blessed Eretz Yisrael yields 50,000 kor; of settled Zoan, 70 kor

moves.cueHe: דתניא, אמר רבי מאיר
moves.summary: R' Meir saw 70 kor per beit se'a at Beit She'an
moves.about: R' Meir's observation of 70 kor per beit se'a in the Beit She'an valley grounds the Zoan figure

moves.cueHe: ואין לך מעולה בכל ארצות יותר מארץ מצרים
moves.summary: Egypt is the finest land and Zoan its finest region

moves.cueHe: ואין לך טרשים בכל ארץ ישראל יותר מחברון
moves.summary: Hebron is the rockiest part of Israel, used for burial

moves.cueHe: ואפילו הכי, חברון מבונה על אחת משבעה בצוען
moves.summary: even so Hebron was sevenfold more fertile than Zoan

moves.cueHe: מאי נבנתה
moves.summary: what does נבנתה mean?
moves.about: what נבנתה means in the verse

moves.cueHe: אילימא נבנתה ממש
moves.summary: suggests literal building
moves.about: a literal reading is impossible, since Canaan (Hebron) was younger than Mizraim

moves.cueHe: אפשר אדם בונה בית לבנו קטן
moves.summary: no one builds for the younger son first; Mizraim is older than Canaan

moves.cueHe: אלא שמבונה על אחת משבעה בצוען
moves.summary: it means sevenfold more developed

moves.cueHe: והני מילי בטרשים
moves.summary: that is rocky land; non-rocky yields 500
moves.about: the 490-kor figure applies to rocky land; non-rocky land yields 500

moves.cueHe: והני מילי שלא בברכותיה
moves.summary: in blessed years a hundredfold, as with Isaac, reaching the baraita's 50,000
moves.about: those figures apply in unblessed years; in blessed years a hundredfold, reaching the baraita's 50,000

moves.cueHe: תניא, אמר רבי יוסי
moves.summary: a se'a in Judea yielded five se'a
moves.about: R' Yosei: a se'a in Judea yielded five se'a of products

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה ההוא צדוקי לרבי חנינא
moves.summary: a sectarian attests his one beit se'a yields everything
moves.about: confirms the land's praise from his own one beit se'a that yields oil, wine, grain, legumes and pasture

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה ההוא בר אמוראה לבר ארעא דישראל
moves.summary: how much do you pick from the Jordan-bank palm?
moves.about: how many kor you pick from the palm on the Jordan bank

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: שיתין כורי
moves.summary: sixty kor

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: אכתי לא עייליתו בה אחריבתוה
moves.summary: you have already ruined it; we got 120
moves.about: Israel has already ruined the land, which gave 120 kor under the Amorites

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: אנא נמי מחד גיסא קאמינא לך
moves.summary: I meant one side only
moves.about: sixty kor was only one side of the tree

moves.cueHe: אמר רב חסדא, מאי דכתיב
moves.summary: why is the land likened to a deer?
moves.about: why Eretz Yisrael is likened to a deer: its skin cannot hold its meat; it is swift to ripen fruit

moves.cueHe: לומר לך: מה צבי זה אין עורו מחזיק בשרו
moves.summary: like a deer's skin that cannot hold its meat, the land cannot hold its fruit

moves.cueHe: דבר אחר: מה צבי זה קל מכל החיות
moves.summary: alternatively, swift like a deer to ripen its fruit

moves.cueHe: אי מה צבי זה קל ואין בשרו שמן
moves.summary: then perhaps its fruit is lean like deer meat
moves.about: whether the deer analogy also implies the land's fruit is not fatty, as deer meat is lean

moves.cueHe: תלמוד לומר: זבת חלב ודבש
moves.summary: fatter than milk and sweeter than honey
moves.about: the land's fruit is fatter than milk and sweeter than honey

moves.cueHe: רבי אלעזר כי הוה סליק לארץ ישראל
moves.summary: on ascent, ordination and intercalation seat, he counts curses escaped

moves.cueHe: שנאמר: והיתה ידי אל הנביאים
moves.summary: Ezekiel's three curses: intercalation, ordination, entering the land

moves.cueHe: רבי זירא כי הוה סליק לארץ ישראל
moves.summary: he crossed the Jordan holding a rope

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה ההוא צדוקי: עמא פזיזא
moves.summary: rash people, still rash
moves.about: crossing the Jordan by a rope rather than waiting for a ferry shows Jewish rashness, as at Sinai

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: דוכתא דמשה ואהרן לא זכו לה
moves.summary: who knows if I will merit what Moses and Aaron did not
moves.about: Moses and Aaron did not merit entering; he hurried lest he be prevented

edges.about: a beit se'a of blessed Eretz Yisrael yields 50,000 kor; of settled Zoan, 70 kor
R' Meir's observation of 70 kor per beit se'a in the Beit She'an valley grounds the Zoan figure
Egypt is the most excellent of lands
Zoan is Egypt's finest region, since kings were raised there
Hebron was sevenfold more fertile than Zoan
what נבנתה means in the verse
a literal reading is impossible, since Canaan (Hebron) was younger than Mizraim
Mizraim is older than Canaan

edges.cueHe: אלא שמבונה על אחת משבעה בצוען
edges.about: נבנתה means more developed (fertile) sevenfold
the 490-kor figure applies to rocky land; non-rocky land yields 500
those figures apply in unblessed years; in blessed years a hundredfold, reaching the baraita's 50,000
Isaac's hundredfold yield in a blessed year
R' Yosei: a se'a in Judea yielded five se'a of products

edges.cueHe: אמר ליה ההוא צדוקי לרבי חנינא
edges.about: confirms the land's praise from his own one beit se'a that yields oil, wine, grain, legumes and pasture

edges.cueHe: אמר ליה ההוא בר אמוראה לבר ארעא דישראל
edges.about: how many kor you pick from the palm on the Jordan bank
sixty kor

edges.cueHe: אמר ליה: אכתי לא עייליתו בה אחריבתוה
edges.about: Israel has already ruined the land, which gave 120 kor under the Amorites

edges.cueHe: אמר ליה: אנא נמי מחד גיסא קאמינא לך
edges.about: sixty kor was only one side of the tree
why Eretz Yisrael is likened to a deer: its skin cannot hold its meat; it is swift to ripen fruit

edges.cueHe: אי מה צבי זה קל ואין בשרו שמן
edges.about: whether the deer analogy also implies the land's fruit is not fatty, as deer meat is lean
the land's fruit is fatter than milk and sweeter than honey
milk and honey read as fatter than milk, sweeter than honey

edges.cueHe: זה סוד עיבור ... זה סמיכה ... כמשמעו
edges.about: 'council of My people' = intercalation; 'register of Israel' = ordination; 'land of Israel' = literal
